confirmedFindings: Existing melee engagement slots, bounded local routing, approach charges, hard contacts and cancellation tests can be reused.
Current target choice does not allocate squad damage jointly with reachable attack-position capacity.
A current regression intentionally keeps a sieged tank stationary after a movement order; the new requirement changes that behavior contract.
Real attacks include immediate hits, weaponFlights and multiple delayed/area attack subsystems; visual projectiles are not a damage ledger.
Existing approach charges can ignore both friendly and hostile live-body contact; a new ordinary melee speed bonus must not silently inherit or remove that approved behavior.
Current mode fields do not distinguish manual preference from automatic choice; player Lurker underground movement already exists.
Carrier children, stationary mission allies and autonomous equipment bodies have separate behavior/ownership scopes.
recommendation: Retain fixed-step simulation, terrain routing and contact solver. Add hard command arbitration and bounded deterministic joint target/position/firepower allocation with side-effect-free estimates and rebuildable reservations.
